findings.detail: heavyLockHeld uses existsSync(lockPath). A file existing does not mean an exclusive lock is held. Recommended commands omit actual flock.
identityVerdict receives indexSha:null; expected hash is optional and the helper only compares when both exist. No actual served index/bundle binding is proved.

After F offer at E, the new probe waits in place for W test unless witness objective appears. A legitimate fixed-reference long route has no witness hold, so Terra can block E indefinitely. Move to proven reachable clear ground using actual controls and measure actual-body clearance before waiting.

walkTo uses minimum120ms key pulse, about0.6units at measured5.2u/s; common corner approach needs materially finer control. Fixed coarse taps may oscillate around small arrival radii while stallMs resets. Calibrate/adapt small pulses and stop an observed oscillation honestly.
Some F calls use only any-prompt regex and no exact objective, and a-real-drawing gate result is ignored before later F. Enforce actual expected objective/prompt and every failed prerequisite.
